en.title: Amazon SageMaker Inference adds Multi-Instance GPU to cut AI costs
en.summary: Amazon SageMaker Inference now supports **Multi-Instance GPU (MIG)**, letting you divide a single physical GPU into multiple isolated partitions. This means you can run **multiple AI models** on one GPU without wasting resources, and avoid the complex setup of doing this manually on Kubernetes.
en.long_summary:
## How GPU Partitioning Works
Previously, when you deployed an AI model to a GPU endpoint, you had to request at least one whole accelerator. This often led to wasted hardware because many models do not need an entire A100 or H100 chip. With the new **SageMaker GPU partitioning**, powered by NVIDIA MIG, you can divide a physical GPU into up to seven independent partitions. Each partition gets its own dedicated compute power and memory, enforced strictly at the hardware level.

## Key Benefits and Cost Savings
This hardware-level isolation ensures **predictable latency** and strict fault containment, meaning a traffic spike or crash in one model will not affect others on the same chip. AWS testing showed that using a smaller slice of a newer, powerful GPU (like an H100) can actually deliver **better performance and lower costs** compared to using a whole older GPU, striking a much better balance for real-world production workloads.

zh.title: 亚马逊 SageMaker 推理现在支持 GPU 切割，帮你省下真金白银
zh.summary: 亚马逊 SageMaker 推理现在支持 **GPU 多实例切片（MIG）** 技术，允许把一块完整的显卡拆成多个独立的小格子。这样你就能在**同一张显卡**上同时跑好几个 AI 模型，不用再为浪费算力或复杂的集群配置而头疼了。
zh.long_summary:
## GPU 切割是怎么回事
以前在云端部署 AI 模型时，最低消费就是整整一张显卡。但现实是，很多模型根本用不完一张 A100 或者 H100 的全部性能，造成了极大的浪费。现在通过 **SageMaker 的 GPU 切割功能**，借助英伟达的 MIG 技术，你可以把一块大显卡切成最多七个独立的小格子。每个格子都有专属的算力和内存，彼此互不干扰。

## 核心好处与实际省钱效果
这种硬件级别的隔离能带来**更稳定的响应速度**，而且一个模型崩了或者并发暴涨，也不会连累隔壁的其他模型。亚马逊测试发现，用高端显卡（比如 H100）的一个切片来跑模型，不仅**性能比老显卡更好**，而且均摊下来还能省下不少钱，给企业提供了更灵活的部署选择。

en.title: NVIDIA Open Source Tools Help Researchers Build Next-Generation 6G Networks
en.summary: NVIDIA's open-source 6G and 5G software tools, like Aerial and Sionna, have seen a **tenfold growth** in global adoption over the past year. Researchers are using these tools to build smarter networks that help **robots react faster**, improve signal reception, save power, and speed up network simulations.
en.long_summary:
Over the past year, NVIDIA's open-source wireless tools have surpassed 1 million downloads, being adopted by more than 8,000 research institutions worldwide. These platforms bridge simulation and AI training with real-world wireless systems, aiming to build AI-native 6G networks.

Researchers at King's College London used Sionna to enable robots to transmit compact descriptions instead of full images, cutting task completion time by up to **52.6%**. Meanwhile, SoftBank and ETH Zurich demonstrated that AI receivers can significantly improve signal decoding under interference, achieving up to a **60% gain** in uplink throughput.

Additionally, universities like Leeds are using AI to predict network demand and manage base station power, cutting RAN energy consumption by **45.6%**. Institutions like CTTC are also leveraging GPU acceleration to slash network simulation times from hours down to minutes, paving the way for faster 6G innovation.

zh.title: 英伟达开源工具助力研究人员打造下一代 6G 网络
zh.summary: 英伟达旗下的 Aerial 和 Sionna 等开源 6G 和 5G 软件工具，在过去一年里全球下载量和使用量迎来了**十倍增长**。研究人员正在利用这些工具打造更聪明的网络，不仅能帮**机器人反应更快**，还能更好地接收信号、省电以及加快网络模拟测试。
zh.long_summary:
在过去的一年里，英伟达的开源无线工具下载量已经突破 100 万次，被全球 8000 多家研究和学术机构使用。这些平台将虚拟仿真、AI 训练与真实的无线系统连接起来，目标是打造以人工智能为核心的 6G 网络。

来自伦敦国王学院的研究人员利用 Sionna 让机器人只传输精简的物体描述而非完整的图像，成功将机器人的任务完成时间缩短了 **52.6%**。同时，软银集团和苏黎世联邦理工学院的研究表明，AI 接收器可以在干扰环境下更好地解码信号，使上行吞吐量提升高达 **60%**。

此外，利兹大学等机构利用人工智能来预测网络需求并智能管理基站开关，成功将基站能耗降低了 **45.6%**。加泰罗尼亚电信技术中心（CTTC）还利用 GPU 加速将原本需要数小时的网络模拟时间缩短至十几分钟，大幅加快了 6G 技术的研发步伐。

en.title: ToyBlocks: A controlled world for robot learning and evaluation
en.summary: Researchers have introduced **ToyBlocks**, an open simulation framework designed to help robots learn how to handle, sort, and stack objects. By providing a controlled environment with realistic physics, it allows scientists to automatically **generate training data** and test why robots succeed or fail, ultimately bridging the gap between simulation and real-world robot deployment.
en.long_summary:
## Background and Design
To understand why complex AI systems succeed or fail, scientists often rely on controlled environments. ToyBlocks is the first 'FoundationWorld' designed for robotics, featuring a simulated tabletop with a robot arm and blocks. It fulfills four key requirements: **realistic physics**, automatic task generation, a combination of reasoning and dexterity, and broad task coverage. Unlike messy real-world scenarios, its narrow scope allows researchers to rigorously track performance.

## Capabilities and Experiments
ToyBlocks uses reinforcement learning and motion planning to automatically generate skills like pushing and flipping blocks without tedious remote control. Researchers tested various AI models using this framework. For instance, vision-language-action models often struggled with spatial generalization, while advanced reasoning models like Claude could use tools to solve block-stacking tasks. Additionally, action-conditioned world models were evaluated for their ability to predict physical interactions accurately, with **Wan 2.2** performing best.

## Real-World Transfer
Policies trained entirely inside ToyBlocks were successfully transferred to physical robots zero-shot. By carefully tuning simulation parameters and randomizing visual properties, the **low-level skills** achieved success rates in the real world that closely matched their performance in simulation, proving the framework's value for future robotics research.

zh.title: 玩具积木：用于机器人学习与评估的受控虚拟世界
zh.summary: 研究人员推出了**玩具积木**（ToyBlocks）开源模拟框架，旨在帮机器人学习如何抓取、分类和堆叠物体。通过提供带有真实物理效果的受控环境，它允许科学家自动**生成训练数据**并测试机器人成功或失败的原因，从而最终缩小模拟与现实世界机器人部署之间的差距。
zh.long_summary:
## 背景与设计
为了弄清复杂人工智能系统成功或失败的原因，科学家们通常依赖受控环境。ToyBlocks 是首个专为机器人技术设计的“基础世界”，包含一个带有机械臂和积木的模拟桌面。它满足四个关键要求：**逼真的物理效果**、自动任务生成、推理与灵活性结合以及广泛的任务覆盖。与杂乱的现实场景不同，其狭窄的范围使研究人员能够严格追踪性能表现。

## 功能与实验
ToyBlocks 利用强化学习和运动规划来自动生成诸如推动和翻转积木等技能，无需繁琐的远程遥控。研究人员利用该框架测试了各种 AI 模型。例如，视觉语言动作模型在空间泛化能力上往往表现不佳，而像 Claude 这样的高级推理模型则可以使用工具来解决积木堆叠任务。此外，研究人员还评估了动作条件世界模型准确预测物理交互的能力，其中 **Wan 2.2** 表现最好。

## 现实世界迁移
完全在 ToyBlocks 内部训练的策略被零样本成功迁移到了实体机器人上。通过仔细调整模拟参数并随机化视觉属性，其**底层技能**在现实世界中的成功率与模拟中的表现高度吻合，证明了该框架对未来机器人研究的价值。

en.title: US Midterm Results Spell Trouble for Elon Musk and AI Data Centers
en.summary: The recent US midterm elections brought a **blue wave** that could spell trouble for tech giants and AI data centers. Voters across the country rejected data center projects, and politicians who promised to restrict them won office. Even **Elon Musk** found himself empty-handed after donating massive sums to Republicans while his companies remain based in a newly blue state. In response, AI companies like OpenAI are trying to change their tune by dropping secret deals and rebranding data centers as **compute campuses** to appease the public.
en.long_summary:
## Political Backlash
The recent US midterm elections have created a rocky road for the tech industry, particularly regarding AI data centers. Across the country, voters rejected local ballot measures that would have paved the way for new data centers, while electing politicians who campaigned on restricting them. Notable figures like Elon Musk are now in an awkward position, having donated massive amounts to the Republican Party only to find their companies headquartered in a state that has turned heavily Democratic.

## Grassroots Resistance
Experts note that the backlash against data centers is not just a partisan issue, but an **increasing grassroots movement**. Tech companies have historically pushed through projects using secretive tactics, demanding non-disclosure agreements from local officials and ignoring community concerns over environmental issues and water scarcity in sensitive regions.

## Corporate Response
In response to mounting political pressure and changing market dynamics, tech companies are starting to pivot. OpenAI recently released a new policy blueprint promising to ditch NDAs and share project plans openly. They are even attempting to rebrand data centers as **compute campuses** to shake off their toxic public image, though industry observers remain skeptical about whether this cosmetic change will actually solve the growing regulatory and financial hurdles.

zh.title: 美国中期选举结果出炉，马斯克和AI数据中心要头疼了
zh.summary: 最近的美国中期选举迎来了民主党的胜出，这可能会给科技巨头和AI数据中心带来麻烦。全国各地的选民纷纷拒绝数据中心项目，承诺限制数据中心的政客也赢得了选举。就连**马斯克**在向共和党捐赠巨额资金后也发现自己竹篮打水一场空，而他的公司还总部设在一个变成了蓝色的州。为了平息民愤，像OpenAI这样的AI公司开始改变策略，不再搞秘密协议，甚至把数据中心改名叫**计算园区**来挽回公众好感。
zh.long_summary:
## 政治风向转变
美国最近的中期选举给科技行业带来了不小的麻烦，尤其是AI数据中心的发展开始受阻。在全国各地，选民们投票反对旨在加速数据中心建设的提案，并选出了承诺要限制数据中心发展的政治人物。像马斯克这样的大佬现在处境尴尬，他之前给共和党砸了巨资，结果自己的公司却留在一个全面转向民主党的州里。

## 基层民众抵制
业内专家指出，反对数据中心的浪潮并非单一党派问题，而是一个**日益高涨的基层运动**。过去科技公司在推进项目时往往采用遮遮掩掩的战术，要求地方官员签署保密协议，忽视了敏感地区的环境问题和水资源短缺，引发了民众的不满。

## 科技公司妥协
面对越来越大的政治压力和华尔街的财务质疑，科技公司开始做出调整。OpenAI最近发布了新的政策蓝图，承诺不再使用保密协议，并公开项目计划。他们甚至试图把数据中心改名为**计算园区**，以此来摆脱负面形象，不过业内人士对这种换汤不换药的做法能否真正解决监管和资金难题持怀疑态度。

en.title: Wave Forcing: Towards Speed-of-Light Streaming Video Generation
en.summary: Researchers have introduced **Wave Forcing**, a new framework that makes AI video generation much faster and smoother. By letting different parts of a video **overlap their processing**, this system achieves incredible speed while keeping the video quality high and natural, solving the annoying lagging and quality drops in older methods.
en.long_summary:
## Background
Generating long AI videos in real-time has always been tough because older methods process video chunks one by one, causing delays and making the video quality drop over time.

## Details
Wave Forcing uses a clever trick called **wavefront scheduling**, meaning later parts of the video start generating before the earlier parts are completely finished. It also comes with a special runtime system called WaveRT that speeds up communication between GPUs and handles heavy workloads efficiently.

## Impact
Tests show this system can run at incredible speeds, reaching **134.8 end-to-end frames per second** on multiple GPUs, which is a massive performance boost that brings us much closer to real-time, live AI video generation.

zh.title: Wave Forcing：迈向光速般的流式视频生成新技术
zh.summary: 研究人员推出了一种名为 **Wave Forcing** 的全新AI视频生成技术，能让视频生成变得飞快且流畅。它通过让视频的不同部分**同时处理**，在保持画质清晰和动作自然的同时，大幅提升了生成速度，解决了以往技术容易卡顿和画质变差的老毛病。
zh.long_summary:
## 背景
实时生成长视频一直是AI领域的难题，因为老方法必须一块一块地串行处理视频，不仅速度慢，而且视频生成时间一长画面就会开始崩溃或跑偏。

## 细节
这项新技术采用了一种叫作**波前调度**的妙招，让后面的视频片段不等前面的完全搞定就能提前开工。同时，研发团队还配套推出了专属的运行加速系统，通过优化显卡之间的配合与数据传输，把效率压榨到了极致。

## 影响
测试结果表明，该系统在多张高端显卡上能跑出每秒 **134.8帧的惊人速度**。这种性能的大幅飞跃，让我们向真正的实时流式AI视频生成迈出了一大步。

en.title: thedotmack/claude-mem: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent
en.summary: ⭐ 114,583 | Your AI coding agent **forgets everything** between sessions, making you repeat yourself and walk back into old mistakes. Claude-Mem runs a quiet observer alongside your agent to take notes, compresses them with AI, and automatically **injects relevant context** into your next session so it always picks up right where you left off.
en.long_summary:
## Detailed Features
Claude-Mem solves the universal headache of AI agents starting from zero every time a new session begins. It captures everything your agent does during a session, uses AI to compress the activity into concise observations, and **injects relevant context** back into future sessions. It supports major agents like Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, Cursor, and more, ensuring you never have to re-explain your codebase.

## System Architecture & Installation
The system relies on a local worker service managed by Bun, lightweight lifecycle hooks that intercept tool calls, and a SQLite database paired with Chroma for hybrid keyword and vector search. To get started, you simply run **`npx claude-mem install`** in your interactive terminal, which automatically discovers supported agents on your machine and sets up the necessary hooks and workspace.

## Usage & Search Tools
Once installed, Claude-Mem runs completely on its own in the background. It features a token-efficient three-step MCP search workflow (`search`, `timeline`, and `get_observations`) that saves up to 90% of tokens by fetching full details **only when needed**. You can also check a live web viewer to monitor ongoing work, track progress, and manage your project memory effortlessly.

zh.title: thedotmack/claude-mem：为所有 AI 编程助手提供跨会话的持久化上下文
zh.summary: ⭐ 114,583 | 你的 AI 编程助手在每次对话结束后就会**失忆**，导致你不得不一遍遍重复需求、重复踩坑。Claude-Mem 会在后台默默当一个“记笔记的小助手”，把 AI 做过的事用人工智能压缩好，并在你开启新对话时自动**注入关键记忆**，让它无缝衔接之前的工作。
zh.long_summary:
## 详细功能
Claude-Mem 彻底解决了 AI 助手每次开启新会话时都会“清零”的痛点。它会记录 AI 在工作时的一举一动，用 AI 提炼并压缩成简短的观察记录，然后在未来的会话中**自动注入上下文**。它支持 Claude Code、OpenClaw、Codex、Gemini、Cursor 等主流 AI 工具，让你再也不用向 AI 反复解释代码库。

## 系统架构与安装说明
该系统采用由 Bun 管理的本地服务、拦截工具调用的轻量级生命周期钩子，以及结合了 SQLite 与 Chroma 向量数据库的混合搜索架构。安装非常简单，只需在终端运行 **`npx claude-mem install`**，它就会自动扫描你电脑上支持的 AI 助手并完成所有配置。

## 使用说明与搜索工具
安装完成后，Claude-Mem 就会在后台完全自动化运行。它提供了一套极其省 Token 的三步走 MCP 搜索工作流（`search`、`timeline` 和 `get_observations`），**只在需要时**才去获取详细内容，能节省高达 90% 的 Token。此外，你还可以通过网页端随时查看工作进度、管理项目的历史记忆。

en.title: Worktrunk: A CLI for Git worktree management, designed for parallel AI agent workflows
en.summary: ⭐ 11,981 | Worktrunk is a command-line tool that makes **Git worktrees** as easy to use as regular branches. It solves the annoying, multi-step process of managing separate directories for different tasks, making it super smooth to run **multiple AI agents** in parallel without them stepping on each other's toes.
en.long_summary:
## What is Worktrunk?

Worktrunk is a specialized **CLI tool** built in Rust designed to streamline Git worktree management, specifically tailored for developers running parallel AI agent workflows like Claude Code or Codex. Git's native worktree feature lets you have multiple working directories for the same repository so different agents don't mess up each other's changes, but the default Git commands are clunky and require typing branch names multiple times and manually switching directories.

## Core Features and Workflow

Worktrunk simplifies this entire process down to a few intuitive commands. With **core commands** like `wt switch`, you can create a new branch, set up a worktree, and jump straight into it instantly. It also supports advanced features such as workflow automation hooks, automated LLM-generated commit messages, a streamlined merge workflow, an interactive picker with CI status previews, and shared build caches across worktrees using advanced filesystems.

## Installation

Worktrunk can be easily installed on macOS, Linux, and Windows using popular package managers. For instance, Mac and Linux users can install it via **Homebrew** with the command `brew install worktrunk && wt config shell install`. Windows users can install it via Winget as `git-wt` to avoid command conflicts with Windows Terminal.

zh.title: Worktrunk：为并行 AI 代理工作流设计的 Git 工作树管理工具
zh.summary: ⭐ 11,981 | Worktrunk 是一个命令行工具，它让 **Git 工作树** 的使用想像普通分支一样简单。它解决了为不同任务管理独立目录时繁琐的多步骤痛点，让你能极其顺畅地同时运行 **多个 AI 代理** 而互不干扰。
zh.long_summary:
## 这是什么项目？

Worktrunk 是一个用 Rust 编写的专用 **命令行工具**，旨在简化 Git 工作树的管理，特别适合需要运行诸如 Claude Code 或 Codex 等并行 AI 代理工作流的开发者。Git 原生的工作树功能允许你为同一个仓库拥有多个工作目录，防止不同代理互相干扰，但原生的 Git 命令非常笨拙，需要多次输入分支名称并手动切换目录。

## 核心功能与工作流

Worktrunk 将整个过程简化为几个直观的命令。通过诸如 `wt switch` 的 **核心命令**，你可以一键创建新分支、设置工作树并直接切进去。它还支持各种高级特性，比如工作流自动化钩子、自动生成 LLM 提交信息、流畅的合并工作流、带 CI 状态预览的交互式选择器，以及在高级文件系统上跨工作树共享构建缓存。

## 如何安装

你可以通过主流的包管理器在 macOS、Linux 和 Windows 上轻松安装 Worktrunk。例如，Mac 和 Linux 用户可以通过 **Homebrew** 运行 `brew install worktrunk && wt config shell install` 来安装。Windows 用户可以通过 Winget 安装为 `git-wt`，以避免与 Windows 终端的命令冲突。
